description: Searches US CBP binding customs rulings (CROSS database) by keyword and returns ruling number, subject, date, classified tariff number, category and whether it was modified or revoked. Results are the first page of the CBP search (up to 20); it is not a legal opinion. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
